# AMEVA-Forge (v1.0.0)
> Browser-Native WebGPU Autograd Deep Learning Engine & Real-Time Interactive Studio

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/AMEVA-Forge
- Installation: `pip install ameva`
- Architecture: Executes PyTorch-compatible dynamic tensor computations via raw WebGPU WGSL compute shaders with deterministic weakref buffer pooling and zero memory leaks.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import ameva as am

# 1. Initialize WebGPU tensor computation
device = am.device("webgpu" if am.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
x = am.randn(64, 128, device=device, requires_grad=True)
w = am.randn(128, 10, device=device, requires_grad=True)

# 2. Forward pass and backpropagation
y = am.matmul(x, w).relu().sum()
y.backward()
print("Gradients computed on WebGPU:", w.grad.shape)

```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
